links.reported_relation: selfdestruct forces at least 1 wei onto the Slipstream SwapRouter, and with any ETH balance every swapAndBridgeWithETH/swapAndBridgeWithERC20 call fails.
the victim's swapAndBridge transaction calls exactInput and the Slipstream router then attempts to refund its ETH balance to TrustSwapAndBridgeRouter.
TrustSwapAndBridgeRouter has no receive/fallback, so the ETH refund reverts and the whole swap-and-bridge transaction reverts instead of completing.
